title: Archival manifest
description: Site-level configuration for an archival site, read from archival.toml at the site root.

upload_prefix.description: this string is appended to all upload paths, used for differentiating sites using the same uploads_url

uploads_url.description: the host url of the CDN used for uploads

archival_version.description: an optional version string to indicate the minimum version of archival this site is compatible with

prebuild.description: a list of shell commands to run before building this site

site_url.description: a url that will be available to this site's liquid files as site_url, which can also be used by the archival editor

site_name.description: a name for this site, used by the archival editor and other machine readers of this manifest

object_file.description: the file that archival uses to read the objects schema for this site

pages.description: the folder that archival looks for page liquid files in

objects.description: the folder that archival looks for object toml files in

schemas_dir.description: the folder that the archival schemas command generates schemas into

build_dir.description: the folder that archival builds your site into

static_dir.description: the static dir that is copied directly to your build dir

layout_dir.description: the folder that archival reads layouts from

metadata.description: arbitrary string metadata about this site, used by the archival editor and other machine readers of this manifest

editor_types.description: a dictionary of custom-defined editor types, keyed by the type name used in archival_objects.toml

type.description: the type that this custom type is backed with. May be a built-in archival type, or the name of another editor type defined in this manifest.

editor_url.description: a URL to load a custom editor from. If unspecified, will use the underlying type's editor

validate.description: a list of validations to run on fields of this type

anyOf.description: a regular expression to run on this field's string representation
a regular expression to run on a path inside a nested field (meta, upload, video, audio or image)

path.description: a path inside a nested field to validate

validate.description: a regular expression to run on this field at the specified path
